Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Generate a personal API key in Linear Settings > API > Personal API keys.
Settings.DefaultTeamIdDescription: Required. Team where issues will be created. Click Validate after saving the API key to load teams and projects; this only reads from Linear.
Settings.CachedTeamsDescription: Showing {0} cached Linear team(s). Click Validate to refresh.
Settings.DefaultProjectIdDescription: Optional. Issues will be added to this project when set. Click Validate to load projects.
Settings.CachedProjectsDescription: Optional. Showing {0} cached Linear project(s); choose one that belongs to the default team.
Settings.NoTeamsFound: No teams found for this API key.
Settings.RefreshFailed: Could not load teams and projects; the previous list was kept. Check the API key and your connection.
Settings.TeamsRefreshed: Found {0} team(s) and {1} project(s). Options refreshed.
Settings.ApiKeyNotConfigured: Linear API key not configured. Please set it in plugin settings.
Settings.DefaultTeamNotConfigured: Default team ID not configured. Please set it in plugin settings.
Settings.IssueCreateFailed: Failed to create Linear issue. Check logs for details.
Settings.IssueCreateUncertain: Linear did not confirm the issue. It may still have been created; check Linear before trying again.
Settings.IssueCreateCancelledUncertain: Issue creation was cancelled after the request was sent. Check Linear before trying again.
